title: Glioma-Classification v3.0.0: analysis code and WHO 2021 label release for "Diagnostic label–IDH discordance and machine-learning classifier performance on a legacy TCGA glioma grading benchmark"
description:
Analysis notebook (Glioma_Grading_R3.ipynb), its source script (build_notebook.py), locked decisions, result tables and figures for an audit of the UCI/TCGA Glioma Grading benchmark (UCI dataset 759, doi:10.24432/C5R62J). Four model families are compared by nested cross-validation with all decisions locked before a held-out test set is scored; errors are related to agreement between the legacy LGG/GBM label and IDH status; and approximate WHO 2021 categories are reconstructed by linking TCGA case identifiers to published molecular annotations (Ceccarelli et al., Cell 2016; cBioPortal study lgggbm_tcga_pub pinned at datahub commit 18763f8eee86d4886d7210068f745f1e509498ee). The release includes a versioned patient-level label file (Data/Release) with a datasheet (Data/DATASHEET.md), SHA-256 checksums of all external inputs, and pinned Python 3.13 package versions.

Research use only. The reconstructed WHO 2021 categories are approximate and must not be used for clinical diagnosis.
